intent: Prevent nested subclass data from bypassing a declared response schema

signals: top-level filtering works but a nested object leaks an extra field
the nested value is a subclass of the declared response type
the response validator clones schema fields before serialization

steps: Run the focused regression test and distinguish the working outer filter from the failing nested filter.
Trace how the response schema is cloned at every model boundary.
Check whether nested model fields are reused by identity while only the outer field is cloned.
Recursively apply the existing field-cloning operation to nested model fields.
Rerun the focused test and confirm both outer and nested undeclared fields are absent.
failures: Do not blacklist the sensitive field name; enforce the declared schema generically.
Do not remove the optimization globally or edit serialization output after validation.
Do not change the regression test or the model inheritance relationship.
recovery: When an outer response field is cloned to break trusted input-model inheritance, recursively clone nested model fields too; a shallow clone leaves a nested trust path intact.

outcome.verification: Nested subclass-only fields are removed while declared nested fields remain
